From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2024 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Deep technical deep-dive + Dedicated GPU pool sizing

Hi Daniel —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for walking us through Novara's high-level use case and the health records redaction flow. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the logistics for the sizing call: 

Summary from my side:
- Primary ask: real-time redaction for ingestion pipeline + batched clinical summarization jobs.
- Target latency requirement: p95 <= 200ms for the real-time path (user-facing).
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~200 req/s, with weekend/peak bursts up to ~600 req/s for batched jobs.
- Data residency: US only, potentially HIPAA-covered so Private/Dedicated deployment is likely.

Proposed next steps:
1) Book a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive + dedicated pool sizing call (we'll bring the runtime/ops engineers).
2) You fill the attached short load profile (novara-load-profile.csv) before the call — helps us model batching and cache benefits.
3) We'll share a draft mutual action plan and an initial recommended pool config prior to the call.

Candidate slots (PDT):
- Monday 08/12, 10:00–11:15
- Tuesday 08/13, 13:00–14:15
- Wednesday 08/14, 09:00–10:15

If none of those work, tell us your team's preferred windows and Connor/Ben will align. Attached: redwood-postcall-checklist.pdf (short pre-call asks).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — really helpful recap and clear asks. A few notes from our side and a couple of clarifying questions before we lock a time: 

A) Load/profile details (quick):
- Typical user prompt size (post-system): ~300–400 tokens for redaction; summarization jobs average ~1,200 tokens.
- Steady-state: 180–220 req/s to the real-time endpoint; p50 latency requirement is flexible but p95 we want to keep under 200ms as you noted.
- Peak: monthly financial-report run causes batched bursts that can hit ~600 req/s for short windows (~10–20 min).

B) Compliance note: We are assessing whether Dedicated (VPC) + KMS integration will satisfy our controls. Happy to go into the compliance checklist during the call.

C) Availability for a 75-min block: we can do Tuesday 08/13 13:00–14:15 PDT. That works for Mark (ops) and me. Could you add an optional 30-min follow-up for capacity tuning if needed?

D) Is it helpful for you if we share a short anonymized sample (1–2 prompts + expected redacted output) ahead of the call? We can attach to the CSV.

We'll fill the CSV and drop it into the Drive link you provided by Monday morning.

Thanks — Daniel
Director, Platform Engineering
Novara Health

- 5m: Intros & success criteria (Laura)
- 10m: Novara production flow + datasets (Daniel + Mark)
- 25m: Redwood runtime deep-dive (Ben) — batching, KV cache, quantization options, and latency controls

Invite includes a 30-minute optional follow-up the next day for tuning — left as "optional" on the calendar. If anything changes, ping Connor directly. Looking forward to it.
